title: SwedCraft
description: Tools, block and much more in the future!
body:
This mod is currently on its 1:st version and we will update it.

This mod adds:
Swed (gem)
swedpickaxe
swedaxe
swedshovel
swedsword
swedhoe
swedblock
swedore

ADDED NEW MININGRING!

Tntickaxe (Pickaxe that leaves explosions after it)

EVERYTHING has its own recipe!
You will need to find the SwedOre to craft the SwedTools!
